main_issue: Who works the first blank day around Hari Raya Puasa (two of four must be on duty), given A, B and D all want it off, C will work if given Christmas off, and no one will move; D proposes drawing lots while A refuses.

A-B.evidence: A offers to cover two shifts (T15); B says 'That doesn't help me with childcare' (T16). Both still insist on the day off; neither gives way.

A-C.evidence: C offers to work both days for Christmas off (T3, T20). A never responds to C, though C's offer would help A.

A-D.evidence: D pushes lots as the only fair way (T23, T25); A rejects it: 'I can't put that on a random draw' (T26).

B-C.evidence: B says 'none of us can work that day' (T19); C replies that C can work it if given Christmas (T20). B does not take up C's offer.

B-D.evidence: D builds on B's second-day arrangement (T8) and both say they cannot give up the first day (T10, T12). B does not respond to the lots idea.

C-D.evidence: D counts C as covering the second day (T8), but D's later lots proposal ignores C's offer to work for Christmas off (T20).
